answer_2.quote: We assess the performance of models both at the token-and sequence-levels. Results are reported overall and per file. Token-level metrics measure the quality of the binary classification per word / token. Precision, recall and F1 scores are then computed with the scikit-learn library. Strict sequence match (SSM) scores, such as precision, recall and F1 scores, measure the extent to which the predicted DS sequences strictly match the ground-truth ones. These are computed with the seqeval library. We also employ another sequence-level score: Zone Map Error (ZME).
